request: User: Iansan accepted, try regenerating Aether Lumine and Diluc. Earlier request authorized each character’s attached in-game model in addition to official art.
method: built-in image_gen, one asset per call

references.role: official portrait: identity, costume and illustration style
user-provided in-game model: identity, costume and color

tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait: preserve the character identity, costume details and polished anime illustration style. Image 2 is the user-provided in-game model: use it to guide accurate face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Translate the character into an elegant illustrated sprite with petite Medium Male proportions. Character-appropriate relaxed pose: friendly, attentive and adventurous: stand at ease with a slight three-quarter angle, both arms lowered naturally and hands separate at his sides. Face generally toward the viewer, hair and clothing hanging naturally. Hands are separate and naturally articulated; each has a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. One coherent mouth. No weapon. Include the entire silhouette, hair, hands, accessories and shoes with about 2–4% padding above and below. Genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or baked ground shadow.
